App details

Stopwatch & Multi Timer

Time activities with a stopwatch and several named countdown timers running together.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Stopwatch with current laps plus multiple named timers, presets and timer history.

Main features

  • Record lap and split times.
  • Save timer presets and view timer history.
  • Timers continue with the screen off.
  • Sound, vibration and notifications when time is up.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Stopwatch, timers and saved durations

Stopwatch and lap times

Start, pause and resume one stopwatch. During a run, record numbered laps with total time and time since the previous lap. Reset returns to zero and clears the current lap list; laps belong to that session.

Several independent timers

Create named countdowns with positive durations, for example separate cooking steps. Each timer has start, pause, resume and reset. Remaining time and running, paused or finished status are shown clearly. Restart begins its original duration again, including after expiry.

Presets and timer history

Save a named duration as a preset to create a timer quickly; edit or delete presets later. Timer history records names, durations, start/finish information and whether a run finished, was cancelled or reset. Clear history separately; stopwatch laps do not enter it.

Background timing and alerts

Timers continue in the background and with the screen off. Sound and vibration are separately adjustable; notifications depend on Android permission and device behaviour. Denying notifications leaves in-app timing available. Recovery uses saved timing information; unrecoverable stopwatch sessions are marked interrupted rather than inventing elapsed time.

The impatient stopwatch

Tap the About logo seven times to reveal a playful stopwatch. If you wait instead of starting it, impatient messages appear and it eventually starts itself. This offline scene closes without changing your real timers, presets or history.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
